title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Edible Oils, Gold, Silver, Brass Scrap, and Areca Nuts; New Rates Effective August 15, 2026
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Edible Oils, Gold, Silver, Brass Scrap, and Areca Nuts; New Rates Effective August 15, 2026

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne edible oils, gold, silver, brass scrap, aur areca nuts ke Customs Tariff Values revise kiye hain. Yeh naye rates **August 15, 2026** se effective ho gaye hain.

Here's a quick lowdown for all importers and stakeholders:

*   **Notification Number:** Notification No. 70/2026-Customs (N.T.)
*   **Notification Date:** August 14, 2026
*   **Effective Date:** The revised tariff values are effective from August 15, 2026.
*   **Key Commodities Affected:** The revision impacts crude and refined palm oils, palmolein, crude soybean oil, brass scrap, gold, silver, and areca nuts.
*   **Purpose:** These revisions are part of CBIC's ongoing efforts to update tariff values in response to prevailing valuation considerations, ensuring accurate customs duty assessment under Section 14(2) of the Customs Act, 1962.
*   **Specifics (some examples):**
    *   Crude Palm Oil: US$ 1,208 per Metric Tonne (MT)
    *   RBD Palm Oil: US$ 1,220 per MT
    *   Crude Soybean Oil: US$ 1,257 per MT
    *   Brass Scrap (all grades): US$ 7,945 per MT
    *   Specified Gold: US$ 1,407 per 10 grams
    *   Specified Silver: US$ 2,097 per kilogram
    *   Areca Nuts: US$ 11,574 per MT
